text: Hello Consumer Financial Protection Bureau, XX/XX/XXXX I signed a car lease agreement with XXXX XXXX XXXXXXXX XXXX AMERICAN CAR CENTER in XXXX, North Carolina. The car was a XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX and the agreed upon value which is stated in my lease was {$21000.00}. XX/XX/XXXX my car stopped while I was driving to get on the highway and would not start once I tried to keep starting it. I contacted ACC that same day and was told they have ties with XXXX and to tow it .. since it was under 30 day warranty. Upon arrival I was told that the engine blew and was not able to contact the finance team of the company, in which I previously had contact with! XXXX XXXX XXXX contact XXXX XXXX the regional manager for this company. I was contacted and they put me in a rental car. 4 days go by I hear nothing. 6 days go by and I contact again and hear nothing. I go back to the establishment I purchase the car from and the lot has no cars and has the door padlocked. I immediately felt as if I was scammed. Then I go on XXXX and see they have filed for bankruptcy out of nowhere and left town, this is all public record. The car does not work or move and I have not drove it at all. XXXX is still in possession of the vehicle because no I was not able to pay for an engine. Now they have sold my information to a place called Westlake Portfolio and they are hitting my credit for a XXXX auto loan. I have never had any contact with this company! I have no access to the vehicle and once again I never ever signed anything with this company they should have no information of mine. This is really hurting my credit. I have contacted them several times on behalf of This matter and have received no response. This whole situation was fraudulent behavior and I just need help.
